value.rationale: The literature introduces the invariant but erroneously proposes a sharp bound 2. A globally sharp sqrt(2) bound precludes that proposed behavior in every real Banach space and identifies exactly the flat unit-sphere geometry responsible for equality. This resolves a natural sharp constant problem and adds a meaningful rigidity distinction for finite-dimensional strictly convex spaces, not an arbitrary finite computation or weak routine variation.
